description: Search recent Google News by keyword and get 10 articles with headline, publisher, link and publish date, from the last day, week or month. No sign-up. Use it when: You need what was published about a topic in the last day, week or month. Not for: Full article text; pass a link to the URL to Markdown node for that. Returns: 10 articles: headline, publisher name and site, link and publish date. Typical time: about 7 s. Price: $0.035 per search (up to 10 articles), charged only on success. One call = up to 10 articles.

period.description: How far back to look; default 7d

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. stablecoin regulation

name: news-search
title: Google News search
